translations.web: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
translations.bsb: And to whom did He swear that they would never enter His rest? Was it not to those who disobeyed?
translations.kjv: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
